children: MultiversX plans to present the first simple business use cases for its Finance Computer, giving merchants and companies a practical path to use the product. Focused workshops are set to follow, walking businesses through what the Finance Computer can unlock for their day-to-day operations.

These use cases are the first disclosed attempt to move the Finance Computer from an announced product into real B2B adoption that runs directly on the MultiversX network. Each deployment would translate merchant and company activity into EGLD usage, giving observers a measurable signal rather than a roadmap claim. Because this is the initial test of the product's B2B push, the scope and specifics of the disclosed cases will shape how the adoption narrative develops for EGLD.
